purpose: Full update timing only; not candidate selection

interpretation: Timing experiment only; no candidate selection or strength claims.
Async scheduling and GPU numerics can change action samples and game trajectories despite common seeds. Compare platform throughput and report workload differences; not pure accelerator causality.
H200 and CPU workers have different host processors and core counts.
Three updates on one host each is a throughput pilot; investigate inconsistent per-update timings before scaling.
Update timers exclude initial/final evaluation and checkpoint uploads. Overall wall time includes those operations and model downloads, but excludes container/dependency startup.
Async engine timing is blocking call wall time, not summed engine CPU time.
GPU utilization is sampled every 5 seconds across the whole process including internal evaluations.
All gradients on HF Jobs; no final-reserved seeds, current cohort modifications or deployment.
